dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Due to the current situation, Ogura Textiles & Kimonos is going through some tough times. We can't just sit here and do nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Miss Ogura's father was once a relative of the Kujou Clan. If we don't help each other, that would put the samurai name to shame."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Please don't worry, Miss Ogura. We'll round up some old friends, and we'll help you get through this tough time."

dialogues.speaker: Reply to Message
dialogues.text: "I really appreciate your kindness on my late father's account, but I am afraid I must decline."

dialogues.speaker: Reply to Message
dialogues.text: "I don't want to trouble everyone over such a small matter. I am sure that my brother and I can make it through."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Miss Ogura, you really are just like your father."
